note: Every rucc pass that runs at a level and rewrites nothing in the whole corpus there, with the reason. A run of the whole corpus fails on a quiet pass this file does not name, and on a line whose pass fired or no longer runs. Regenerate with `rucc-corpus run --accept` and write the reason on every new line.
